stories.title: CDA seals Fazl’s Islamabad residence after 'foreign' owner's CNIC cancelled
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The Capital Development Authority (CDA) on Saturday sealed the Islamabad residence of Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman after the identity card of the property’s legal owner was cancelled.

stories.title: Zardari, Shujaat discuss politics
stories.brief: President Asif Ali Zardari on Friday met with former prime minister and Pakistan Muslim League-Quaid (PML-Q) President Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain at his residence on Friday and discussed the prevailing situation in the country. Sources told The Express Tribune that the president drove straight to the Chaudhry Shujaat's residence from the airport after arriving in Lahore.

stories.title: Israel kills two MSF staff in targeted strike on Gaza clinic
stories.brief: An Israeli strike on a clinic operated by Doctors Without Borders (MSF) in Gaza has killed two watchmen.

stories.title: Death toll in Baloch Colony building collapse rises to 11 as rescuers recover three more bodies
stories.brief: KARACHI: Rescue workers recovered three more bodies from the rubble of a six-storey building that collapsed near Karachi’s Baloch Colony area on Saturday, taking the death toll to 11. In Keamari, 12 of the 19 buildings were sealed and notices were issued to five, while construction work was found to have stopped at one site.

stories.title: Israeli strike kills two Doctors Without Borders staff in Gaza
stories.brief: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) said two of its colleagues, both guards, were killed late Friday in an Israeli strike on one of its clinics in the Gaza Strip.

stories.title: OpenAI countersues Apple for stealing trade secrets
stories.brief: OpenAI sued Apple on Friday, accusing the Big Tech giant of stealing its trade secrets and discouraging hardware suppliers from working on future OpenAI devices, after Apple sued OpenAI for allegedly poaching its employees to gain access to its technology.

stories.brief: The endangered reptiles were bound with duct tape to prevent them moving, officials say.

stories.title: US military says cyber systems secure after reports of Air Force hack
stories.brief: The United States military denied Friday any issues with its computer security following media reports that the Air Force's cloud based system was hacked, in what would be the latest high profile breach of US digital infrastructure in recent weeks.
